info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Call Monitoring API

items.docs: Create a successful monitoring request. It can be done either on an on-going or next successful inbound/outbound call. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique ID representing the task that needs to be barged by the supervisor.

items.docs: Create a successful barge-in request for the supervisor to barge in the call that is being monitored already. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique ID represents the task that needs to end.

items.docs: Allows to successfully end the on-going monitoring request. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique ID representing the task that needs to be held.

items.docs: Place the monitoring session on hold for a particular call. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique ID representing the task that needs to be resumed and was on hold already.

items.docs: Resume a particular monitoring request that was on hold already. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.
Fetches all active subscriptions for a given clientID.

params.name: requestId
params.description: The id with which the monitoring request has been created.

items.docs: Delete a particular monitoring request that was created. Requires scope 'cloud-contact-center:pod_conv' and 'cjp.supervisor'.
